# MTG Lab

MTG Lab is an evidence-driven, reproducible decision-intelligence and research
platform for collectible card games. Magic: The Gathering is the initial game;
Mystery Booster 2 is the reference product. The [product vision](VISION.md)
separates a first useful release from the ultimate research ambition.

## Start here

- [Governance and document responsibilities](docs/GOVERNANCE.md): owner approval,
  routine PM review, Codex delivery and occasional independent Senior PM audits.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [accepted decisions](docs/DECISIONS.md):
  Architecture v13 is ACTIVE APPROVED; Decision 017 is Accepted.
- [Implemented capabilities and limitations](PROJECT_INVENTORY.md),
  [current status](docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md), [handoff](docs/HANDOFF.md) and
  [roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): current work and authorization boundaries.

Executable generic pack simulation and bounded fictional gameplay are present.
Neither proves authentic MB2 collation or real-Magic execution. Real-card
semantic-closure and mana-window assessments are non-executing evidence tools.
The inventory links to their owning contracts and limitations.

# Current project state

Verified baseline: canonical main
`954592cd25e0e29c7d4d2764cad27f77a193a05b`, tree
`effe6749579bee6a61075bf01de3673491cccd21`. The merged history includes generic
pack variants, fictional turn/stack procedures, canonical import recovery,
Real-Card Semantic Closure V1 and Real-Mana Activation-Window Applicability V1.
See the [implementation inventory](../PROJECT_INVENTORY.md) for evidence-linked
capability boundaries. Architecture v13 and Accepted Decision 017 are unchanged.

Documentation Continuity & Vision Canonicalization V1, including its exact
preservation-compatibility amendment, is owner-authorized. Its draft PR and
validation receipts determine delivery readiness; this entry is not a claim of
merge approval or completed CI. The next operational action is independent PM

## Current limits and authorization

- **BLOCKED:** real-card execution and complete semantic closure. Historical
  accepted interpretations and retained rules do not establish current Oracle
  verification or approved real execution procedures.
- **BLOCKED:** authentic statistically defensible MB2 generation. Generic seeded
  simulation does not resolve physical-distribution evidence, identity admission
  or operation-specific source-use gates.
- **PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED:** rules-corpus infrastructure; see the
  [roadmap](ROADMAP.md#proposed-rules-corpus-direction). No bulk source processing
  or public corpus metadata publication is authorized.
- **DEFERRED:** the original two-rule Stage B projection under the owner's change
  of development strategy. No projection is created here.
- Source-policy clearance remains **not_granted**. Broader private retention,
  redistribution, free/commercial service and AI export remain
  **NOT_ESTABLISHED**. No upstream permission is marked GRANTED.
- Canonical admission remains false and execution authority BLOCKED for these
  real-rules evidence lanes. Semantic closure remains OPEN; all ten activation
  responsibilities remain OPEN / EXECUTION_BLOCKED. Tier A remains non-production.

[VISION](../VISION.md) states enduring ambitions; [GOVERNANCE](GOVERNANCE.md)
states the approval workflow. This milestone does not change product behavior,
protected evidence, Research Log authority or permissions.

## Proposed rules-corpus direction

**Complete Single-Release CR Structural Inventory V1 — PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED.**

The PM accepted the scaling assessment as a proposed technical direction. Its
architecture separates (1) verified structural inventory, (2) typed rule
relationships, (3) independently reviewed semantic batches, and (4) explicit
consumer admission. Extracted identifiers or citation edges do not establish
reviewed semantic understanding or admitted gameplay/Card Intelligence behavior.

A possible phased path is structural inventory for one pinned release, dependency
and batch-review tooling, substantive semantic/procedural review, then separately
approved consumer integration. None of these phases is authorized by this entry.
The first proposed milestone would inventory one complete release, preserve exact
source spans and hashes, expose unresolved references and reconcile historical
anchors without creating semantic approvals or execution authority.

Before any implementation, obtain a separate operation-specific source-use
disposition and explicit owner authorization covering:

1. Whole-artifact transient structural parsing.
2. Private derived metadata retention.
3. Any proposed public metadata publication.

The two-rule PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS disposition does not authorize these broader
operations. Upstream permissions remain NOT_ESTABLISHED; source-policy clearance
remains not_granted. No full-corpus processing, new projections or publication
occurs in this documentation milestone. No first-release feature set or timeline
is approved here.
